title: Whatever your language,
information stays easy.
language.body: Browse in 한국어, English, 日本語 or 中文. Site language and a clinic's actual interpreters or English-speaking staff are listed separately.

transparency.title: Clear about what each piece of information is
transparency.subtitle: We separate sources and never promise what can't be verified.

items.title: Clinic information
items.body: Names, addresses and phone numbers come from Naver Maps search. Treatments, prices, hours and language support should be confirmed with the clinic.

items.title: Visitor experiences
items.body: Reviews are personal experiences from people who proved their visit with a receipt. They do not verify or guarantee any medical outcome.

items.title: What you should confirm
items.body: Check the final cost, side effects, recovery time and interpreter conditions directly with the clinic before treatment.

items.q: Why do I need to upload a receipt?
items.a: It proves you actually visited, so every review comes from a real patient.

items.q: Can other users see my receipt?
items.a: No. Receipts are stored privately and used only for verification.
Your receipt goes to a manual review queue. You can write your review once it is approved.
